39563-and-the-kaiser-abdicates-the-germa.creator: Unknown

61319-introduction-to-our-bird-friends-v.title: Introduction To Our Bird Friends Volume 1
61319-introduction-to-our-bird-friends-v.creator: Unknown
61319-introduction-to-our-bird-friends-v.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Altho protected by the Federal Migratory Bird Treaty, this heron often finds himself the target for thoughtless hunters. Not that he would make a tasty dish, but any bird which stands 4 feet high with a wing spread of almost 70 inches is in constant danger. His favorite feeding grounds are wet meadows or pastures, ponds, lakes or streams.

arxiv-2007-02871.title: DART: Open-Domain Structured Data Record to Text Generation
arxiv-2007-02871.creator: Linyong Nan, Dragomir Radev, Rui Zhang, Amrit Rau, Abhinand Sivaprasad, Chiachun Hsieh Xiangru Tang Aadit Vyas Neha Verma Pranav Krishna, Yangxiaokang Liu Nadia Irwanto Jessica Pan Faiaz Rahman Ahmad Zaidi, Murori Mutuma Yasin Tarabar Ankit Gupta Tao Yu Yi Chern Tan, Xi Victoria Lin Caiming Xiong Ri
arxiv-2007-02871.description: Abstract We present DART , an open domain structured DA ta R ecord to T ext generation dataset with over 82k instances (DARTs). Data-to-Text annotations can be a costly process, especially when dealing with tables which are the major source of structured data and contain non-trivial structures.

arxiv-2011-10789.title: lospre in linear time
arxiv-2011-10789.description: Abstract Lifetime-optimal speculative partial redundancy elimination (lospre) is the most advanced currently known redundancy elimination technique. It subsumes many previously known approaches, such as common subexpression elimination, global common subexpression elimination, and loop-invariant code motion. However, previously known lospre algorithms have high time complexity; faster but less powerful approaches have been used and developed further instead.

arxiv-2109-10291.title: A Quantum-Inspired Classical Solver for Boolean k k -Satisfiability Problems
arxiv-2109-10291.creator: S. Andrew Lanham, Brian R. La Cour
arxiv-2109-10291.description: Abstract In this paper we detail a classical algorithmic approach to the k k -satisfiability ( k k -SAT) problem that is inspired by the quantum amplitude amplification algorithm. This work falls under the emerging field of quantum-inspired classical algorithms.

arxiv-2202-12792.title: Separable symmetric tensors and separable anti-symmetric tensors
arxiv-2202-12792.creator: Changqing Xu
arxiv-2202-12792.description: Abstract In this paper, we first introduce the invertibility of even-order tensors and the separable tensors, including separable symmetry tensors and separable anti-symmetry tensors, defined respectively as the sum and the algebraic sum of rank-1 tensors generated by the tensor product of some vectors, say, v 1 , v 2 , … , v m \textbf{v}_{1},\textbf{v}_{2},\ldots,\textbf{v}_{m} .

arxiv-2210-10845.title: Obstacle problems with double boundary condition for least gradient functions in metric measure spaces
arxiv-2210-10845.creator: Josh Kline
arxiv-2210-10845.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Josh Kline. In the setting of a metric space equipped with a doubling measure supporting a ( 1 , 1 ) (1,1) -Poincaré inequality, we study the problem of minimizing the BV-energy in a bounded domain Ω \Omega of functions bounded between two obstacle functions inside Ω \Omega , and whose trace lies between two prescribed functions on the boundary of Ω .

arxiv-2303-17434.title: A re-investigation of debris disc halos Preprint: P. Thebault
arxiv-2303-17434.creator: P. Thebault, J. Olofsson, Q. Kral
arxiv-2303-17434.description: Abstract Context. Scattered-light images reveal that a significant fraction of debris discs consist of a bright ring beyond which extends a wide halo. Such a halo is expected and should be made of small grains collisionally produced in the ring of parent bodies (PB) and pushed on high-eccentricity orbits by radiation pressure.

arxiv-2308-15251.title: Bayesian ensemble modelling to monitor excess deaths during summer 2022 in Switzerland
arxiv-2308-15251.creator: Garyfallos Konstantinoudis, Anthony Hauser, Julien Riou
arxiv-2308-15251.description: Abstract Switzerland experienced one of the warmest summers during 2022. Extreme heat has been linked to increased mortality. Monitoring the mortality burden attributable to extreme heat is crucial to inform policies, such as heat warnings, and prevent heat-related deaths. In this study, we evaluate excess mortality during summer 2022, identify vulnerable populations and estimate temperature thresholds for heat warnings.

arxiv-2310-15638.title: CoAnnotating: Uncertainty-Guided Work Allocation between Human and Large Language Models for Data Annotation
arxiv-2310-15638.creator: Minzhi Li Taiwei Shi Caleb Ziems Min-Yen Kan Nancy F. Chen Zhengyuan Liu Diyi Yang, National University of Singapore Institute for Infocomm Research (IR), A*STARUniversity of Southern California Stanford University li.minzhi@u.nus.edu taiweish@usc.edu cziems@stanford.edu nfychen@i2r.a-star.edu.sg li
arxiv-2310-15638.description: Abstract Annotated data plays a critical role in Natural Language Processing (NLP) in training models and evaluating their performance. Given recent developments in Large Language Models (LLMs), models such as ChatGPT demonstrate zero-shot capability on many text-annotation tasks, comparable with or even exceeding human annotators.

arxiv-2402-17515.title: Integrated, bright, broadband parametric down-conversion source for quantum metrology and spectroscopy Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2402-17515.creator: René Pollmann, * Franz Roeder, Victor Quiring, Raimund Ricken, Christof Eigner, Benjamin Brecht, and Christine Silberhorn
arxiv-2402-17515.description: Abstract Broadband quantum light is a vital resource for quantum metrology and spectroscopy applications such as quantum optical coherence tomography or entangled two photon absorption. For entangled two photon absorption in particular, very high photon flux combined with high time-frequency entanglement is crucial for observing a signal.

arxiv-2406-12729.title: Spin-Peierls instability of deconfined quantum critical points
arxiv-2406-12729.creator: David Hofmeier, Josef Willsher, Urban F. P. Seifert, Johannes Knolle
arxiv-2406-12729.description: Abstract Deconfined quantum critical points (DQCPs) are putative phase transitions beyond the Landau paradigm with emergent fractionalized degrees of freedom. The original example of a DQCP is the spin-1/2 quantum antiferromagnet on the square lattice which features a second order transition between valence bond solid (VBS) and Néel order.

arxiv-2407-13561.title: Research on Tibetan Tourism Viewpoints information generation system based on LLM
arxiv-2407-13561.creator: Jinhu Qi, Shuai Yan*, Wentao Zhang, Yibo Zhang, Zirui Liu, Ke Wang
arxiv-2407-13561.description: Abstract Tibet, ensconced within China’s territorial expanse, is distinguished by its labyrinthine and heterogeneous topography, a testament to its profound historical heritage, and the cradle of a unique religious ethos. The very essence of these attributes, however, has impeded the advancement of Tibet’s tourism service infrastructure, rendering existing smart tourism services inadequate for the region’s visitors.

arxiv-2503-22043.title: Shuffle squares and ordered nest-free graphs Thanks: The manuscript was originally entitled Graphic images of shuffle squares Thanks: The first author was supported by Narodowe Centrum Nauki, grant 2020/37/B/ST1/03298. Thanks: The third author was supported by Narodowe Centrum Nauki, grant 2024/53/B
arxiv-2503-22043.creator: Jarosław Grytczuk, Bartłomiej Pawlik, Andrzej Ruciński
arxiv-2503-22043.description: Abstract . A shuffle square is a word consisting of two shuffled copies of the same word. For instance, the Turkish word 𝚒𝚔 ​ 𝚒 ​ 𝚕𝚒 ​ 𝚔𝚕𝚒 \mathtt{\color[rgb]{1,0,0}{ik}\color[rgb]{0,0,1}{i}\color[rgb]{1,0,0}{li}\color[rgb]{0,0,1}{kli}} ( binary in English) is a shuffle square, as it can be split into two copies of the word 𝚒𝚔𝚕𝚒 \mathtt{ikli} .

arxiv-2601-21591.title: The roles of bulk and surface thermodynamics in the selective adsorption of a confined azeotropic mixture
arxiv-2601-21591.creator: Katie L. Y. Zhou, Anna T. Bui, Stephen J. Cox
arxiv-2601-21591.description: Abstract Fluid mixtures that exhibit an azeotrope cannot be purified by simple bulk distillation. Consequently, there is strong motivation to understand the behavior of azeotropic mixtures under confinement. We address this problem using a machine-learning-enhanced classical density functional theory applied to a binary Lennard–Jones mixture that exhibits azeotropic phase behavior.

europmc-pmc5796059.creator: Altmann C, Schmidt MHH.
europmc-pmc5796059.description: Diabetic retinopathy is a common complication of diabetes mellitus, which appears in one third of all diabetic patients and is a prominent cause of vision loss. First discovered as a microvascular disease, intensive research in the field identified inflammation and...

pmc-10643958.title: The clinicopathological characteristics and survival outcomes of primary expansile vs. infiltrative mucinous ovarian adenocarcinoma: a retrospective study sharing the experience of a tertiary centre
pmc-10643958.creator: Sabina Nistor, Sally El-Tawab, Flora Wong, Andreas Zouridis, Rene Roux, Sanjiv Manek, Kezia Gaitskell, Ahmed Ashour Ahmed, Sean Kehoe, Hooman Soleymani majd
pmc-10643958.description: BackgroundMucinous ovarian carcinomas (MOCs) are rare ovarian tumours accounting for 3% of all epithelial ovarian carcinomas (EOCs). They are either expansile or infiltrative, based on the tumour’s histological pattern of invasion. MOCs have a distinct molecular profile, natural history, chemo-sensitivity, and prognosis compared to other EOCs.

pmc-11344175.title: ﻿Discovery of a new tarantula species from the Madrean Sky Islands and the first documented instance of syntopy between two montane endemics (Araneae, Theraphosidae, Aphonopelma): a case of prior mistaken identity

pmc-11344175.description: ﻿AbstractThe Chiricahua Mountains in southeastern Arizona are renowned for their exceptional biodiversity and high levels of endemism. Morphological, genomic, behavioral, and distributional data were used to report the discovery of a remarkable new tarantula species from this range. Aphonopelmajacobiisp. nov. inhabits high-elevation mixed conifer forests in these mountains, but also co-occurs and shares its breeding period with A.

pmc-11455491.title: 7220 Menopause Has a Beneficial Influence on the Evolution of Prolactinomas: a Study in 95 Patients
pmc-11455491.creator: Stefan Matei Constantinescu, Caterina Nava, Fanny Chasseloup, Philippe Chanson, Orsalia Alexopoulou, Dominique M Maiter
pmc-11455491.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Constantinescu: None. Chanson: Consulting Fee; Self; Eli Lilly & Company, Recordati, Ipsen, Novo Nordisk. Maiter: Consulting Fee; Self; Ipsen, Recordati, Pfizer, Inc.The natural occurrence of menopause is considered to have beneficial effects in women with a prolactinoma and represents a window of opportunity for successful dopamine agonist (DA) withdrawal. Strong evidence for these effects remains however scarce.

pmc-11638368.title: Exploring the experiences of sonography students with simulation‐based learning: A perspective from South Africa
pmc-11638368.creator: Geordean Schwartz, Kathleen Naidoo, Ferial Isaacs
pmc-11638368.description: IntroductionSimulation‐based learning (SBL) is widely used in healthcare education to provide a safe environment for students to practice clinical scenarios without causing patient harm. While established in developed countries, SBL's implementation is new in South Africa; there is a lack of research addressing sonography students' experiences.

pmc-12634411.title: Phase Ib study of berzosertib, carboplatin, gemcitabine, and pembrolizumab in patients with squamous nonsmall lung cancer (ETCTN 10313)
pmc-12634411.creator: Liza C Villaruz, Benjamin Schluger, Hong Wang, James Ohr, Daniel Petro, Alexander D Fuld, Benjamin Herzberg, Richa Dawar, Jorge Nieva, Jimmy Ruiz, Susan M Christner, Julianne L Holleran, Christopher J Bakkenist, Steven Gore, Jan H Beumer
pmc-12634411.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundBerzosertib is a potent and selective inhibitor of ataxia telangiectasia Rad3-related and potentiates cisplatin and gemcitabine in lung xenografts. We hypothesized that berzosertib plus carboplatin, gemcitabine, and pembrolizumab is tolerable and active in newly diagnosed advanced squamous NSCLC.MethodsThis phase Ib clinical trial studied berzosertib 135 mg/m2 IV Days 2 and 9 with carboplatin AUC 4-5 Day 1, gemcitabine 800 mg/m2 Days 1 and 8, and pembrolizumab 200 mg Day 1, of a 3-week cycle.

pmc-12687989.title: Complete recovery from chronic implant-induced paresthesia after implant removal: a case report
pmc-12687989.creator: Ji Hyun Paik, Nan Ju Lee, Junglim Choi, Tae Min You, Seung-Rye Song
pmc-12687989.description: Inferior alveolar nerve (IAN) injury is one of the most significant adverse outcomes of dental implantation. IAN injury can occur because of direct invasion of the mandibular canal, compression from implant placement, or postoperative hematoma formation. These injuries may result in prolonged neurosensory disturbances, and the prognosis largely depends on how quickly treatment is initiated.

pmc-13395603.title: Anti-NMDA-receptor encephalitis and MOGAD associated optic neuritis: a case series
pmc-13395603.creator: Pooja Parthasarathi, Michael Dattilo, Jason Peragallo
pmc-13395603.description: IntroductionAnti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis is a well-recognized autoimmune condition that often presents with neuropsychiatric symptoms and seizures. Myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease (MOGAD) often manifests as optic neuritis and, less frequently, as acute demyelinating encephalomyelitis or transverse myelitis. The co-occurrence of anti-NMDAR encephalitis and MOGAD is becoming increasingly recognized, but clinical series remain limited.
